name: Logan High
description: Catch up with the lives of the pupils of Logan High, as they navigate the highs and lows of relationship dramas, friendship fall outs, family issues, school stress and general randomness of life in a modern high school.

videos.title: New Kid in Town
videos.overview: It’s Skye’s first day, but how will she cope with being the newbie?

videos.title: Who Stole the Money?
videos.overview: JT is embarrassed that people think he stole Morag’s charity money.

videos.title: Gossip Girls
videos.overview: Evie struggles to keep up in Chemistry, while James spins a web of lies.

videos.title: Popular
videos.overview: Alex looks to Saskia for advice on how to be popular.

videos.title: Music Battle
videos.overview: Jessica and Skye battle it out for a place on a prestigious music exchange program

videos.title: Star-Crossed Essays
videos.overview: Mr Ukeni sets the class an essay on Romeo and Juliet.

videos.title: Help!
videos.overview: Jessica is broken-hearted about missing out on the exchange programme.

videos.title: Girl Talk
videos.overview: Rachel and JT team up to make Melissa jealous. Lachlan spills the beans about Jo and Evie

videos.title: Dance Off
videos.overview: It’s school dance time and Melissa flouts school rules by wearing make-up.

videos.title: The Contest
videos.overview: Mr. Z sets the class a competition to write a love song.

videos.title: Lyrical
videos.overview: Lloyd is made to sing his romantic lyrics about Saskia in front of the class in Music.

videos.title: American Boy
videos.overview: A new American exchange student called Clayton arrives at school.

videos.title: On the Beach
videos.overview: The boys don’t like Clayton and his confidence with the girls.

videos.title: Liar Liar
videos.overview: James lies about his musical prowess in order to impress Mr Z.

videos.title: Love is Complicated
videos.overview: Mrs C tackles the gossip in the Logan Letter about her affair with Mr Z.

videos.title: Ancient History
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked to hear about Clayton’s return to the States. Rachel attempts to let Stuart down gently, but Melissa has a scheme to make sure he and Rachel land with a bump.

videos.title: Boys on Strike
videos.overview: Saskia and Lloyd’s new relationship flourishes until Mattie, fresh from being rejected by Chanel, rallies the guys to call a strike on talking to girls. How long can it last?

videos.title: So Long, Farewell
videos.overview: The netball team’s first match approaches, but Evie has planned a surprise for Jo’s birthday - which will Jo choose? Surprising news from JT leaves Melissa in tears. Alex rallies to comfort her - could their friendship be blossoming?

videos.title: Nailed It
videos.overview: Evie gets a frosty response from Jo on receipt of her birthday gift. Patrick attempts to patch things up with Morag, and let Jessica down gently. Mattie stirs suspicion as he lets slip some detailed knowledge about nail care…

videos.title: Day Job
videos.overview: A careers advice session gets everyone thinking about life after school. Jessica feels insecure about the upcoming no uniform day, so she suggests a shopping trip with the girls. Mr Ukeni submits Patrick’s writing to a competition, with interesting results.

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.overview: Saskia struggles to keep the balance between mates and dates, as Chanel accuses her of ditching her for a boy. The netball team clash with the boys’ football team, so Evie proposes a head-to-head match to determine who gets to claim the gym hall…

videos.title: Face the Music
videos.overview: Mr Z sets the class a challenge by distributing different genres of music to broaden their horizons. As a result, James’ lying gets out of control, and Chanel steps in to try to avoid serious disaster…

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: Saskia struggles with her body image. Rachel can’t decide what to buy her dad for his birthday, but her endless conversations about it upset Morag.

videos.title: Writing on the Wall
videos.overview: Someone graffitis the boys’ toilets with a homophobic comment about Lachlan, which the others try to hide from him. How will Lachlan feel when he finds out?

videos.title: The Interviews
videos.overview: Chanel recruits James as a reporter for the Logan Letter. Meanwhile, Mattie agrees to give Lloyd a fake interview to help him get a part-time job.

videos.title: School Trip
videos.overview: Lloyd faces a schedule clash between Saskia’s dance performance and his new job. Mattie gets his back up about Chanel recruiting James for the Logan Letter, and Jessica has some unexpected money worries.

videos.title: The Incident
videos.overview: Lloyd faces a smelly problem courtesy of his job at the fishmonger. Alex’s attempts to be there for Melissa when she has a tough time at home expose her own family problem. A racist remark sparks an aggressive face-off in the gym.

videos.title: Detention
videos.overview: Chanel has to question her loyalties when her boyfriend becomes the subject of a school scandal. Struggling to keep up with school and home commitments, Alex lands herself in hot water. Lloyd shocks everyone with a big decision…

videos.title: Grief
videos.overview: As everyone deals with the aftermath of Lloyd’s departure, Stuart seems to be particularly dejected. Jessica presses further to find out what’s eating him. Meanwhile, Patrick panics as his diary goes missing.

videos.title: Friend Goals
videos.overview: Patrick feels like a bad friend for not knowing how to help a grieving Stuart. Can he manage to unite the group to support him?

videos.title: Following
videos.overview: When Evie gets calls and texts from an unknown number she suspects someone in the school is messing with her – but who? Elsewhere, Melissa meets Rio, a handsome boy from the year above, and Morag is cross with Patrick.

videos.title: Detective
videos.overview: Evie and Jo try to work out where the creepy messages are coming from and Evie thinks she’s found a suspect…Saskia and Mattie have very different ideas about Lloyd’s birthday surprise, and Patrick and Morag go on possibly the worst date ever.

videos.title: Splitsville
videos.overview: Lachlan and Jo try to persuade Evie to talk to an adult as she is still getting sinister texts.  Meanwhile, there’s a post on the school website about staff changes at Logan High – what will this mean for the class?

videos.title: Night of the Living Parents
videos.overview: It’s Parents Evening at Logan High. While the class wait to find out who will get a glowing report, and whose academic failures will be unmasked, the identity of Evie’s stalker is about to be revealed.

videos.title: Surveillance
videos.overview: CCTV is installed at Logan High, provoking some strong reactions.  Chanel starts an anonymous poll in the Logan Letter to find out what the opinion of the class really is after finding herself caught in between Mattie and Saskia’s differing views.

videos.title: Queen Bee
videos.overview: New girl Izzy arrives at Logan, and her self-confident behaviour causes a stir straight away. But Izzy doesn’t seem to care about what her new classmates think – much less about making friends with them!

videos.title: The Boy Is Mine
videos.overview: Izzy continues to rock the boat at Logan High and manages to make enemies of both Melissa and Chanel. Elsewhere, what’s happening with Saskia and Lloyd?

videos.title: Boomerang
videos.overview: Melissa vows revenge on Izzy after the events of last episode and reasserts her Queen Bee status. When Chanel also takes revenge for her behaviour, it looks like Izzy will, for the first time, be forced to face the consequences of her actions.

videos.title: Rock Bottom
videos.overview: The class are divided over whether Izzy is genuinely sorry for her behaviour, or just trying to win some support after learning she’s stuck at Logan. Melissa is furious that anyone could contemplate giving Izzy a second chance.  Chanel’s actions come to the attention of Mrs Carter – will she lose the Logan Letter as punishment?

videos.title: Meme
videos.overview: Mattie turns a photo of Melissa shouting at Alex into a meme, but it gets out of control when other students add spiteful comments to the photo. Who will tell Melissa, and how will she react?  Meanwhile, Morag feels she’s on a different wavelength to the rest of her class and makes friends with two students in the year above.  But will they want to hang out with her when they realize she’s Mrs Carter’s daughter?

videos.title: Viral
videos.overview: Izzy goes to Mrs Carter about the Melissa meme- causing Mrs C to confiscate all their phones. A humiliated Melissa skips school when she realises how far the meme has spread.

videos.title: Blame
videos.overview: With Melissa still off school, Mrs Carter continues to investigate who started the meme. Mattie is terrified he will get the blame, especially when Rio finds out about his involvement. Will the real authors of the spiteful comments step forward?

videos.title: Turnaround
videos.overview: Rachel is annoyed to learn that Jessica hasn’t owned up to her part in the spread of the meme, leaving her to take the blame alone. Rio challenges Mattie to a fight after school, and Morag deepens her friendship with her older gang.

videos.title: Fire Fight
videos.overview: After visiting Melissa at home, Alex tries to come up with a plan to stop the meme and help her get back to school...But will it work or make matters worse?  And how will Morag react when her new friends start to make fun of Patrick?

videos.title: The Climb
videos.overview: The group plan a day trip away from Logan to welcome Melissa back to school. How will Melissa react when she finds out the truth about Jessica’s involvement in spreading the meme?

videos.title: Admissions
videos.overview: Jessica decides to confide in Stuart, and Alex is torn between her studies and home life when her Mum is taken into hospital.

videos.title: Cheat
videos.overview: It’s assessment time at Logan High, and everyone is starting to feel the pressure of the upcoming exams.  When Izzy finds the answers to next week’s big maths exam, will the group decide to use them to get better grades?

videos.title: Exam
videos.overview: It’s exam day, and all Jessica’s preparation goes out of the window when Rachel returns to sit the maths test.Patrick is feeling the pressure more than most, and Jo tries to help him cope. Elsewhere, Saskia worries her parents won’t let her audition for dance school when she is late and misses the exam.

videos.title: Mask Off
videos.overview: Mrs Carter reveals the identity of the maths exam cheat in assembly in front of everyone.  Chanel decides to investigate other cases of cheating at school in order to win back her place on the Logan Letter.

videos.title: Back Up
videos.overview: It’s Careers Day at Logan High, and the class think about their futures beyond school. Saskia encourages Patrick to go for the journalism placement, and Stuart is upset when he overhears Jessica telling Mrs C her plans.

videos.title: Experience
videos.overview: Chanel makes a vlog following her classmates on their work placements, and manages to turn up at the most awkward times. How much of this is coincidence, and how much is Chanel putting the story first, yet again?

videos.title: New Dawn
videos.overview: New arrival Lawrence makes friends with Mattie, but their friendship is soon tested when Lawrence takes a prank too far. Elsewhere, Melissa and Izzy support Alex as she waits for her mum to come home from hospital.

videos.title: Talent
videos.overview: Izzy and Melissa host a Talent Show to raise money for the hospital that’s been helping Alex’s mum, but Alex is nervous about taking part. James offers to DJ for Mattie and Lawrence - do any of them have the skills to win a prize?

videos.title: Rotten Apple
videos.overview: Rachel’s back from suspension and wants to make up with Jessica. Can she be trusted? There’s uproar when Mrs Carter bans mobile phones during school hours, and Lachlan tries to make Saskia feel better about missing out on her dance academy audition.

videos.title: Gone Girl
videos.overview: Jessica dumps Stuart over the mystery girl he’s been chatting with online. Lachlan is concerned that Saskia has taken his advice about following her dreams the wrong way.

videos.title: Saskia Come Home
videos.overview: Phones are banned from school, and Chanel and Lachlan find it difficult to contact Saskia. Lawrence and Mattie come up with a get rich quick scheme to take advantage of the ban.  Can they make a profit before Mrs C catches them out?

videos.title: The Number You Are Calling
videos.overview: Jo regrets supporting the phone ban when she understands the consequences for her classmates, especially Alex Meanwhile, Chanel and Saskia make plans to go to college together in Newcastle.

videos.title: Dance
videos.overview: James is desperate for the school dance he’s organised with Chanel to be a huge success.All he wants is to be popular – but does he have everything under control on the night?

videos.title: Tide Turns
videos.overview: The group arrange to meet at the beach and open their exam results together. What does the future hold, and who’ll be back at Logan High next term?
